name: selectbeam
description: Beam your code straight to AI — no copy-paste, no tab-switching.

commands.title: SelectBeam: Send Selection to Browser AI (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek)

selectbeam.defaultTarget.description: Where SelectBeam sends code. 'auto' tries the terminal first and falls back to the clipboard; 'clipboard' always copies; 'terminal' always requires a terminal and shows an error if none exists.

selectbeam.rememberTerminalChoice.description: Remember the terminal picked in the quickpick for the rest of the session (stored in workspaceState) so you are not prompted every time.

selectbeam.askForPrompt.description: After pasting code, ask for an optional instruction to append after the code block. Empty/Escape sends code only. The agent is never auto-submitted.

selectbeam.agentStartDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after launching an AI CLI before pasting code, so the TUI has time to boot.

selectbeam.agentCommands.description: Override launch commands per agent id, e.g. { "copilot": "gh copilot" }. Keys: opencode, claude, codex, copilot, aider.

selectbeam.defaultBrowser.description: Which browser AI to open for 'Send Selection to Browser AI'. 'ask' shows a picker every time; 'last' reuses your last browser pick; otherwise jumps straight to ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek.

selectbeam.rememberBrowserChoice.description: Remember the browser AI picked in the quickpick for 'last' mode (stored in workspaceState).

selectbeam.browserUrls.description: Override browser AI URLs per id, e.g. { "chatgpt": "https://chatgpt.com/" }. Keys: chatgpt, claude, gemini, deepseek.
